overview.short: NCR's greenest industrial hub — featuring Okhla Bird Sanctuary, Buddh International Circuit, botanical gardens, and mega malls.
overview.description: Noida (New Okhla Industrial Development Authority) is a well-planned city in Uttar Pradesh bordering Delhi. Known for its wide tree-lined avenues, bird sanctuaries, motorsport circuits in Greater Noida, and premier shopping malls.
